mentions.note: walker, died aged 88; joined 1930s; policeman in B Division; Police team captain and 10 mile champion; Nijmegan Shield teams 1938, 1939, 1948; Middlesex Inter-Counties 10 miles winning team 1937 and 1949

share.d: A. "Bob" Readman in The Belgravian, the Belgrave Harriers club gazette, 1992: 1 mention in 1 issue.
